shared_elements: human head/face in frontal or profile view
suggestion of headgear or hair mass framing a face
justification: Both surfaces carry figural relief in which a human head with a framing mass of hair or headdress can be made out, but that is the extent of the correspondence. A shows a crowded narrative scene of a horse-drawn chariot with a team of horses, multiple armed figures in pointed helmets, wheels and a groundline of stylised marshland, while B shows only a single large, broad-shouldered frontal figure in very low, heavy relief with no scene, no animals and no narrative context.
